mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval is the plotted ellipse with horizontal semiaxis 5 and vertical semiaxis 3. Right image: The oval depicts the upper circular rim in the drawing of the cylinder.
Rationales: The feature traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the left image and shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the right image. The closed curve through A1, A2, B1 and B2. The continuous oval at the top of the short cylinder above the dashed contour.
